description: Source code for CodecSeeding, a component that seeds media codec properties with default tuning values based on media type, used in Android's mediaformatshaper module.

classes.name: CodecProperties
classes.description: Class responsible for managing codec properties and seeding default media tuning values.

methods.name: addMediaDefaults
methods.description: Seeds default tuning values into the codec properties based on media type, with override control.

methods.name: Seed
methods.description: Initial seeding of default media properties for a codec.

methods.name: Finish
methods.description: Finalizes media property seeding, potentially overriding previous defaults.
